title: SMTP AUTH PLAIN: gated on SMTPS port 465
description: Implement AUTH PLAIN (SASL, RFC 4954) for client submission. Gated on TLS being established — only accept AUTH on connections that arrived via the SMTPS implicit TLS port (1c8.9), never on plaintext. This avoids STARTTLS entirely for submission: clients connect to port 465 (implicit TLS), then AUTH PLAIN. Port 25 MTA-to-MTA does not need AUTH.
